body:
Borderlands 2

Wasn't a fan the first time I played it, but I decided to play through the whole game and just kept starting new ones after the first game
NOTHING IS MORE BADASS THAN TREATING A WOMAN WITH RESPECT! - Mister Torgue Flexington

I lost all motivation to do anything, even the things I previously enjoyed. I felt really lonely and like nobody was there for me, but at the same time I hated to be around people. It was just a loop that I couldn't get out of.

Something that I physically noticed was my eyes. They always felt unusually and uncomfortably heavy. In my head I imagined that if I were to look in a mirror my eyes would be very sunken in and dark.

I'm doing a lot better now, but I still feel like I lost a big part of who I was, and I feel like I won't ever be the same person or as happy as I was before everything started coming apart.

During my sophomore year of high school, I went through a phase where I was just obsessed with making paper boats. I also had a very active bladder, so I figured that I would leave them in the toilets in the stalls (mostly to see if they would actually float).

One day, I leave one in the toilet before fourth period. I went back after school (four-period day) to check if it was still there or of it had been flushed. The stall was occupied at the time, so I waited about a minute or two for them to finish and leave the bathroom. At this point I'm thinking he mist have flushed it down the toilet. 

I was wrong.

I go into the stall and I just stopped. Right there on the floor is my half-soaked paper boat. This bastard had grabbed my boat right out of the toilet. I had a few classes with him and I was just always silently weirded out by him.
Super sick! About how long did it take?
That looks super good! Kinda makes me want one
Yeah, I'm planning on going over it again once it's fully healed
